objective: Upgrade actions/download-artifact from v5 to v8 without changing release semantics, while preserving strict evidence retrieval and release validation.

baseline.description: Release workflow consumes tag-bound Scientific Validation evidence and must remain fail-closed.

correctness.reason: Dependency-only workflow change; correctness is established by CI and release-path validation.

reliability.reason: No production reliability delta is claimed before post-change CI validation.

reproducibility.reason: No scientific-data or model contract is changed.

measurement.trade_off: actions/download-artifact v8 enforces stricter digest mismatch behavior; this is acceptable because release evidence integrity should fail closed.

evidence: Only the download-artifact action version changes.
The release evidence name, run-id binding, release_ref verification, and SHA checks remain unchanged.

root_causes: Initial PR omitted the required cumulative lifecycle record because the change touched a workflow file outside the cycle-record directory.

findings: Dependency-only workflow changes are still meaningful PR changes and must carry a machine-readable lifecycle record.
